info.name: Get public links for an asset

items.docs: This API returns public links to both HLS and DASH manifests for video assets, as well as the Video player HTML embed code to integrate Adaptive Video Streaming links with a supported video player. This endpoint uses the newer, standard UUID format of 8-4-4-4-12, and letters are lowercase. See the example for `asset_id`, and [Note on identifiers](https://api.bynder.com/docs/getting-started#note-on-identifiers) for more information.
